verdict.rationale: The first-party README says Apple Silicon is a first-class citizen, optimized through ARM NEON, Accelerate and Metal. Several independent hands-on reports back this up with fast, usable inference on M1 Macs, including 56–83 ms/token on 7B models and 63 t/s generation with gemma-3-4b. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the Metal backend and its configuration, and benchmarks that explicitly isolate Metal GPU speedups versus CPU-only runs (some community reports may predate Metal support).
